Hon'Ble Vikas Budhwar, J. 
1. Heard Sri K.C. Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri S.K. Singh learned Aga for the
State.

2. This application u/s 528 of Bnss has been preferred to quash the entire criminal proceeding of
Complaint case no.369 of 2015 (Shivani @ Shivangi Jaisawal Vs Abhinav Jaisawal and others),
under section 498A, 323, 504, 506 of I.P.C. & section 3/4 of D.P. Act police station- Chauk, District-
Varanasi, pending before Special Chief Judicial Magistrate, Varanasi by virtue of compromise dated
14.02.2024 duly verified on 30.07.2025.
3.

The applicants herein had earlier approached this Court while filing Application u/s 528 No.
23912 of 2025 in which on 17.07.2025, the following order was passed.-
"1. Heard Sri K.C. Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Pankaj Kumar Rai, learned State Law Officer for the State.

2. This is an application under Section 528 of BNSS filed for quashing the proceeding of complaint case no. 369 of 2015 (Shivani alias Shivangi Jaiswal vs. Abhinav Jaiswal and Ors) U/s 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Chauk District Varanasi pending in the court of Special Chief Judicial Magistrate, Varanasi.
3.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that during the pendency of the aforesaid proceedings, a compromise has been entered into between the parties and the same has been filed before the court of CJM, Varanasi on 14.02.2024 annexure 3 at page-40 onwards.
Relevant averments has been made in para-25 of the application.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that direction be issued for verification and in the meantime interim protection be accorded.
4. Learned AGA, has no objection to the same.

5. Considering the said submission, the application stands disposed of directing the applicants to appear before the court below by 31.07.2025 along with the self attested copy of the present application, certified copy of the order.
On the receipt of the same, the court below shall make endeavour to put to notice the other party and thereafter verify the compromise application as alleged to have been filed by the applicants.

6. Till the 31.07.2025, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in proceeding of complaint case no. 369 of 2015 (Shivani alias Shivangi Jaiswal vs.
Abhinav Jaiswal and Ors) Us 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.
Chauk District Varanasi pending in the court of Special Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Varanasi.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants has invited the attention of the Court towards Annexure-6 at page 63 of the paper book so as to contend that on 30.07.2025, the court below had verified the compromise dated 14.02.2024 which is on record as Annexure-3 at page 39 of the paper book reference whereof has been in para 25 of the application.

Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that the Complaint Case No. 369 of 2015 has been transformed into a new case being Complaint Case No. 3056 of 2015 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC read with Section 3/4 of the DP Act.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that once the compromise stood verified pursuant to the order passed by this Court that now nothing remains to be further proceeded with and the proceedings are liable to be quashed.
5. Learned AGA does not dispute the said fact.

6. Considering the submissions so made across the bar and looking into the fact that the parties have entered into compromise and the same stands verified and in view of the judgment of Gian Singh vs State of Punjab & another: (2012) 10 SCC 303 and State of Madhya Pradesh Vs. Laxmi Narayan: Criminal Appeal No. 349 of 2019, nothing remains to be further proceeded with.
